settings.html: Our story

settings.title: Our Story: Built on Honest Work

settings.editor:
Lenz Heating & Cooling started with a single goal Al Lenz set for himself in 2009: to build the best residential heating and cooling company in Iowa. An Iowa native, Al enlisted in the Marine Corps straight out of Lincoln High School and served four years before coming home to learn the trade.

He studied plumbing, electrical, and boiler systems at DMACC, then heating, cooling, and refrigeration at Vatterott College, where he graduated at the top of his class. From there he worked his way up the ladder the hard way — service technician, service manager, operations manager, and finally general manager — before betting on himself and opening Lenz.

Today Al holds an Iowa Master License in HVAC, heating and cooling, refrigeration, and hydronics, backed by more than 26 years in the industry. But ask him and he'll tell you the license isn't the point. The point is earning your trust before we earn your business — and keeping it long enough to be the company your family calls for years.

We don't just want to earn your business. We want to earn your trust.

settings.html: Our values

settings.editor: No pressure, no upsells, no games. We recommend what your home actually needs — nothing more.
You'll never pay a penny more than your original quote. The price we give is the price you pay.
We're here to build lifelong client relationships, not one-time transactions.
Every technician is background-checked and drug-tested, so you can feel completely safe letting us into your home.

settings.html: The owners

settings.editor: An Iowa native, Marine Corps veteran, and Iowa Master License holder with over 26 years in HVAC. Al built Lenz from the service truck up and still sets the standard for how every home visit should go: honest, clean, and done right the first time.

Jenny joined Lenz in 2016 and co-owns and operates the business alongside Al. An Iowa State University finance graduate with a background as a licensed insurance agent and operations leader, she keeps the office running smoothly and treats every client relationship like family.

settings.html: Why Lenz

settings.title: Why Homeowners Across Des Moines Choose Lenz

settings.editor: Our pricing guarantee means the quote is the final number. We provide free estimates on new equipment and full system replacements because we'd rather build a relationship than nickel-and-dime you.
Heat out at midnight? AC down on the hottest day of the year? Call us day or night — weekends and holidays included. A local Lenz team answers, not a call center.
New equipment and full system replacements are quoted free, with no obligation and no pressure. Repairs carry our standard diagnostic fee, with upfront pricing before any work begins.

Serving our neighbors goes beyond the service call. Through Operation Lenz a Helping Hand, we work with our suppliers to install heating and cooling systems for local families who can't afford them — at no cost to them. We also sponsor youth sports like the UGRA J-Hawks softball and DCG flag football teams, support the Creston Booster Club, and partner with organizations including ChildServe and the American Heart Association.
